items.name: Stakeholder contribution incentives discovery
items.description: Determine which contribution workflows, reminders, summaries, and approval controls increase participation without lowering architecture data quality.
questions: Which stakeholder tasks can be delegated without EA review?
Which reminders and summaries are perceived as useful instead of administrative overhead?
Where should AI assistance suggest model updates and where should it only summarize gaps?

items.name: Transformation governance workflow discovery
items.description: Learn how roadmap governance varies across strategy, PMO, architecture review, and release governance forums.
questions: Which roadmap approvals require architecture review evidence before funding is released?
Which dependency thresholds should automatically create executive escalation?
Which release gates need control evidence versus architecture-decision evidence?

items.name: AI governance buying trigger discovery
items.description: Test whether AI system governance is best positioned as a risk product, EA product, portfolio product, or cross-functional operating model.
questions: Which regulation, board request, audit event, or AI program milestone creates the strongest buying trigger?
Which AI governance artifacts should be visible to architects, security, risk, and portfolio leaders?
Which operating metrics prove that AI governance is improving architecture decisions?
